name: gainwix
description: An AI teammate that deploys your app to Google Cloud Platform without you needing to understand cloud infrastructure. Say "deploy" — it does the heavy lifting.

gcp_project.title: GCP project ID (optional)
gcp_project.description: The Google Cloud project to deploy into (e.g. my-app-prod). Optional — leave it empty (and skip the rest) and /gx-gcp-deploy will find or create one when you deploy. Nothing on this screen signs you in or runs gcloud; it only stores values.

gcp_region.title: GCP region
gcp_region.description: Default Cloud Run region for deployments.

gcp_credentials.title: Service account key (optional)
gcp_credentials.description: Path to a service-account JSON key. Leave empty to use your local gcloud Application Default Credentials.

default_mode.title: Trust mode
default_mode.description: "suggest" = every gate is interactive (recommended). "auto" = Gate 1 may auto-approve, but production promotion always asks.
